extension.summary: B站哔哩必连/DLNA投屏接收端
extension.description: Receive Bilibili mobile casts over the Nirvana (NVA) protocol and play them in Kodi with danmaku subtitles. Discovery, playback, pause/resume/seek, volume and quality switching are supported.
通过哔哩必连（NVA）私有协议接收 B 站手机投屏，在 Kodi 中播放并显示弹幕。支持设备发现、播放、暂停/继续、拖动、音量和清晰度切换。
extension.disclaimer: Unofficial third-party addon. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Bilibili. For personal use with your own account only.
非官方第三方插件，与哔哩哔哩无关联。仅供个人在自有设备上接收自己账号的投屏内容。
